game.title: Gursai (Wrestling)
game.description: A form of traditional Afghan wrestling similar to other Central Asian styles, where two opponents grapple on soft ground, aiming to pin each other's shoulders to the earth.
howToPlay: Step 1: Two wrestlers face each other in a marked circular or square pit filled with soft earth.
Step 2: They begin by shaking hands and attempting to grasp each other's waistbands.
Step 3: The objective is to throw the opponent onto their back with shoulders touching the ground.
Step 4: Wrestlers use a combination of strength, technique, and balance to gain advantage.
Step 5: Grabbing legs below the knee is typically prohibited.
Step 6: Matches continue until one wrestler achieves a pin or wins by points.
Step 7: An elder referee officiates and declares the winner.
Step 8: Victors are celebrated and may receive prizes or cash rewards.
Step 9: Skilled wrestlers gain reputation and may challenge wrestlers from other villages.
Step 10: Training begins in childhood with experienced wrestlers mentoring youth.
